regimes.name: bull
regimes.label: Bull market
regimes.about: Optimism feeds on itself: prices climb steadily and dips get bought quickly. Bull markets usually last much longer than bear markets.

regimes.name: sideways
regimes.label: Sideways market
regimes.about: Nobody is sure what comes next, so prices chop up and down without going anywhere. Frequent trading here mostly pays fees.

regimes.name: bear
regimes.label: Bear market
regimes.about: Fear takes over: prices drift down with bigger swings, and rallies fade. A bear market is officially a fall of 20% or more from the last peak.

regimes.name: crash
regimes.label: Market crash
regimes.about: Panic selling: huge daily drops and wild rebounds, usually over in days. Crashes are rare but they are why risk control matters.
